title: Environmental fate behavior and risk implications of legacy and emerging PFAS across multiple media: a spatiotemporal perspective from Africa and beyond
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00424A, Critical Review
